기술은 타입이 하나이고, 포켓몬은 타입이 하나 또는 둘이다. 기술이 주는:
A move has one type, and a Pokémon has one or two types. The multiplier of the damage a move deals follows the table below. Combinations not in the table are 1x. If a Pokémon has two types, the multipliers against the two types are multiplied together. The larger the multiplier, the greater the damage.
- Fire move: 2x against Grass, 0.5x against Fire·Water
- Water move: 2x against Fire·Ground, 0.5x against Water·Grass
- Grass move: 2x against Water·Ground, 0.5x against Fire·Grass·Flying
- Electric move: 2x against Water·Flying, 0.5x against Grass·Electric, 0x against Ground (no damage)
- Ground move: 2x against Electric, 0.5x against Fire·Grass, 0x against Flying (no damage)
- Flying move: 2x against Grass, 0.5x against Electric
